name: Campo nell'Elba (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, light blue above and red below, with three yellow bees along the division.
history: The comune of Campo nell'Elba was authorised on 24 August 1905 to use a flag divided diagonally red and blue with three golden bees walking along the division, recalling the Napoleonic bees of Elba. The arms were granted by royal decree on 22 April 1897.

features.role: divided diagonally light blue over red
